Creative Analytics Digest (Last 3 Months)

We reviewed 14 ads across 2 objective segments to identify top-performing creative patterns and optimization opportunities.

Sales (Catalog):  
Yellow color ads led the pack, outperforming the Sales (Catalog) average by 44% on performance index, driven by a strong ROAS of 8.0 (26% above benchmark) and a 9% lower CPA. Studio environment and urgency hooks also contributed to success, with ROAS beating average by 15%. On the downside, green color ads underperformed with a 3% lower performance index and a 24% higher CPA than average. Indoor home environments and static pacing showed weaker results.  
No standout cross-crystal combos were identified.  
Ads to scale: 6931025859267, 52568989269671  
Ads to watch: 6918064478467, 52513720317471  
Ads to pause: 52584248577271

Sales:  
White color ads dominated, exceeding the Sales average by 208% in performance index with a stellar ROAS 171% above benchmark and CPA 83% lower. Yellow and blue colors also performed well, beating average ROAS by 87% and 13%, respectively. Cheerful moods and static pacing showed strong engagement. Beige colors and trendy moods lagged, with performance indexes 16-62% below average and CPAs up to 109% higher.  
No notable cross-crystal combos found.
